questions.stem: Why might genetic screening be offered to parents who are both carriers of a genetic disorder?

options.text: To cure the genetic disorder before birth
To change the alleles in the embryo
To inform parents about the risk of their child having the condition
To prevent the parents from having children

questions.explanation: Genetic screening allows parents to be informed about the probability of their child inheriting a genetic disorder. This helps them make informed decisions about family planning.
